Auth.//: Validates the machine tokens the admin API requires. Authority is deliberately unset: the Auth Service publishes a JWKS document but no OpenID discovery document, so the issuer is pinned here instead of being learned from metadata. Port 5091 is the Auth Service's local profile; TASK-047 replaces it with the compose service address.

RabbitMq.//: TASK-043: dedicated vhost, least-privilege user scoped to readings.ingested/readings.attempt (consume) and readings.exchange (publish ReadingStored).

Retention.//: TASK-048: how far back raw readings/ingest_batches/processed_messages are kept before rollup+deletion, and how often the background job runs. Override via Retention__WindowDays / Retention__IntervalMinutes without a code change.
